verdict.rationale: Portkey has open-sourced its AI Gateway component ('We've open sourced our battle-tested AI gateway to the community. You can run it locally with a single command'), giving genuine read access to that portion of the source under an open license. However, the broader Portkey product—observability, admin/governance, model catalog, guardrails, prompt management—is not claimed to be open source, so only a subset of the product's source is inspectable. Missing for 10: evidence of license type/name, confirmation the full platform (not just the gateway) is open source, and any independent corroboration (e.g. GitHub repo star count, community audits).
